::: {.column-page} Hello, and Welcome to my website 🤗. My name is Peyman, a Ph.D. Fellow in Computational Engineering at the University of Stavanger within the Department of Energy Resources. I am a member of the [Decision and Data Analytics research group](https://bratvoldlab.github.io/website/) at the University of Stavanger. I consider myself fortunate to be under the guidance of [Prof. Reidar Brumer Bratvold](https://www.reidar-bratvold.com/) and Dr. Aojie Hong. My current research focus on: **Decision Analysis** - Decision Quality - Sequential Decision Making/Analytics - Behavioral Challenges in Decision Making **Reinforcement Learnings** - Dynamic Programming/Approximate Dynamic Programming and Reinforcement Learning - Q-Learning for finding the Optimal Policy in the American Option Pricing Problem. **Bayesian Optimization** - Stochastic Optimization using Bayesian Optimization. On this site I keep a list of [my publications](papers), [presentations](talks), and [my CV](cv.pdf), as well as a [technical blog](blog.html).

## Education - PhD Fellow in Computational Engineering, [University of Stavanger](https://www.uis.no/en), 2021 - Present - MSc in Computational Modeling and Applied Mathematics (non-degree), [Technical University of Denmark](https://www.dtu.dk/english/), 2019-2020 - MSc in Reservoir Engineering, University of Stavanger, Norway, 2017-2019 - BSc in Reservoir Engineering, Petroleum University of Technology, Iran, 2011-2016 :::
